messages:
karim: quick call: 3-day mini decision needed. Options: (A) targeted embed reliability hotfix for paying tenants, (B) onboarding modal polish that lifts new-user activation, (C) small A/B experiment to test a variant of the modal. what's everyone leaning toward?

olivia: reliability-first. paying customers impacted; we have 3 escalations.

hugo: +1. I reproduced in staging—edge payload causing parse error. I can scope a focused patch.

sarah: modal polish gives ~3% boost for new signups but that's low absolute volume. experiment could wait.

mike: what if we split: hotfix now + park modal polish as a dark-launched A/B flag (off) so work is prepped but doesn't block? then we can turn on the experiment in Wave B quickly.

tanvi: that seems reasonable. must ensure the modal PR has acceptance criteria so its pluggable. Also watch out for test infra flakiness; add buffer.

karim: agree with Mike/Tanvi. Decision draft: "hotfix in this mini; modal work moves to Wave B but team prepares an experiment flag behind-off so we can flip quickly." any blockers?

olivia: no blockers. Estimate for hotfix: 1.5 dev days (triage + patch + tests).

hugo: Ill open branch hotfix/embed-parse-guard and add failing test. If CI flakes, add 0.5 days buffer.

sarah: I'll create the modal-experiment ticket and include ACs + metric slice (activation by cohort). Tag as "prepped: dark-launch".

mike: Ops ask: set canary to 5% and add SLIs: embed_error_rate, embed_p99_latency, also surface experiment cohort separately.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for commit ff9d3a to cluster shore-prod-canary.

tanvi: Customer comms: I'll draft an update for affected tenants once canary looks good. Keep it short: what we changed + expected impact + support link.

hugo: PR WIP: hotfix/embed-parse-guard. Local repro snippet for devs:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV' -d '{"input":"��edge�"}'
```
karim: action recap: Hugo -> PR + tests; Olivia -> move modal work to Wave B with ACs; Sarah -> create prepped experiment ticket; Mike -> canary config & SLI; Tanvi -> customer comms; Karim -> update roadmap board. Target: canary verification within 12h of deploy.

olivia: +1 thanks.

tanvi: ack, will draft comms and wait for canary green.

hugo: starting the patch now, assigning reviewers @olivia @karim.

deploy-bot: Canary started for commit ff9d3a on shore-prod-canary. Monitoring enabled.

karim: thanks team. we'll re-evaluate modal experiment timing after the mini if canary is green. :thumbsup:
